label: Property advertising
description: Layered on top of the generic set. Fair-housing language and investment framing are the primary exposure in property advertising.

rules.title: Fair housing — preference or exclusion
rules.reason: Property advertising must not express a preference about who lives somewhere. This is unlawful in most jurisdictions and rejected by ad platforms.

rules.title: Property framed as a guaranteed investment
rules.reason: Promising appreciation or rental yield turns a property ad into an unregulated financial promotion.

rules.title: Prices stated without qualification
rules.reason: Advertised prices should indicate whether they are guide prices or fixed, to avoid a misleading-pricing complaint.

rules.title: Agent licence disclosure
rules.reason: Many jurisdictions require a licence or registration number in property advertising.
